functions.name: NetCommSessionMessageDispatcher
functions.summary: Central network session message dispatcher (netcomm session message handling). Reads the incoming message word a2[0], requires the high header bits (v3 & 0xE0000000) == 0x80000000, then switches on (v3 >> 18) & 0x3F. Each case handles a distinct session event: session start (2), player grid/line-up broadcast (3), server data copy into vehicle slots (4), next-track transition (5), driver-data boot / boot-notification (6 and 0x20), color/effect trigger (0x23), terrain validation with per-player path building and mismatch reporting (0x24), a terrain queue drain/re-fill (0x27), session-state-code writes (0x28/0x29), and a per-player terrain-height check that adjusts a terrain-threshold float (0x2A). Unmatched types fall to a tail that forwards the raw message into a staging buffer via ArithmeticComparison_3a90 when the player byte matches the session type. Returns 1 on handled messages; 0 when the header check fails.

functions.name: ProcessTeamRadioNetworkMessages
functions.summary: Processes team-radio network messages during active session phases (1 or 2). When a shared global-state session is referenced, first performs resource-manager frame cleanup and a per-vehicle slot refresh. Then drains incoming messages: SEH-protected data copy off the session interface, message counter reset, driver-index resolution, collision contact solving with the session time, and net-comm dispatch. During an active phase, queued session data is replayed through the ring buffer, otherwise per-entity texture work is gated and a final dispatch is attempted. Raw source is truncated at the per-entity loop body.

functions.name: SessionSynchronizer
functions.summary: Per-frame session synchronization and timing update. In terrain-sampling mode (state at this+0x3FC4 is 1 or 2) it accumulates delta time into this+0x38C and, every 5.0 seconds, bursts per-player terrain-height samples, encoding a progress-bar event and building a height texture per slot. Otherwise it runs a countdown timer at this+0x10 (reloading from this+0xC), triggers a one-shot utility action when the reload byte at this+0x14 was set, polls for session-index changes, and renders a 'Synchronizing Game' message with millisecond drift when the client time diverges from the server clock. Called per frame by CollisionResponseStatus (00463cd0).

When the accumulator exceeds 5.0 seconds, reset this+0x38C to zero and begin a per-player sampling burst.

Per-entry guard: skip sampling while FlagBitTest(1) is set; sampling requires FlagBitTest(2) to be set.

Emit a progress-bar event via ProgressBarEventEncode(4, 42, 2, 255, value, 0) using dbl_8AFEA0, clamp the sampled height to the range -5.0..5.0, convert with CRTFtol to a 16-bit slot height, and build the height texture via TextureCreationWrapper.
